svg.title: Bottom: shared ground rail and local bare links, mirrored
svg.text: BOTTOM · ground rail + local bare links
Flip left-to-right; keep USB at top. Column 10 is the shared ground rail.
Each jumper has its own two free holes. Rings mark wire ends; no intermediate joints.
10 × 24 isolated pads · 2.54 mm pitch · USB faces row A; optional sense jumper J1 stays open
